items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Oh yeah, I'm sure I know this, Slim. How poor are you talking about it? His name, his records sound familiar, you know?

ctx.x: What do you think, you know Otis Spann? You ever heard him? He's Muddy Waters, our piano player. No, he wasn't from here. No, no. He's up around Chicago. No, I don't know. I don't think he played in New Orleans really. But I thought you might have known him somehow. Did you know any other people around here at the time, like doing stuff like, playing piano? Yeah, anybody playing harp or anything like that?
Oh yeah, I'm sure I know this, Slim. How poor are you talking about it? His name, his records sound familiar, you know?
Yeah. I wish I could call his real name so I could... His name is Benson, though.
